positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Software and firmware developer for medical devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software and firmware developer for medical devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineering team member in the embedded systems group.
Developed critical real-time software for Class III implantable medical devices.
Wrote and executed tests for various firmware and desktop software modules.
Authored extensive documentation for IEC 62304 compliant medical device software.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
Front-end ASIC design engineering for a full chip integration team at Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) in the Graphics Products Group.
Multiple successful takeouts of industry leading large SoC designs.
Design focus on front-end ASIC development: synthesis, timing analysis, verification, analysis, front end design and ECO methodology.

positions.title: Design Methodology Engineer
positions.description:
Team member in Atmel Corp custom design services business.
Six month internship in the design methodology group. Work focused on ASIC cell library processing, back end/physical design flow development and general ASIC flow support and debugging.

positions.title: Computer Programmer Intern
positions.description: I developed firmware for optical test and measurement equipment. Writing C and assembly code for a Texas Instruments MSP430 prototype board.

positions.title: Junior Systems Administrator
positions.description: I performed basic system administration of networks, Windows and Solaris servers.
